description_zh: 基于 Taro 与 React 的微信小程序全栈底座，封装微信登录、原生能力、WebView、私有文件及支付退款对账，支持按业务场景复用，已上线微信小程序。
description_en: A Taro and React foundation for WeChat Mini Programs, with sign-in, native capabilities, WebView, private files, payments, refunds and reconciliation. Reusable across business scenarios, with a live WeChat Mini Program.
deadline_zh: 已上线微信小程序，持续迭代
content_en:
## Overview

custom_wechat_app is a reusable Taro and React foundation for WeChat Mini Programs, backed by NestJS, Prisma and PostgreSQL.

## Capabilities

- WeChat sign-in, profiles and sessions.
- Native capabilities and WebView integration with isolated authentication.
- Private OSS uploads and short-lived signed access.
- WeChat Pay API v3, refunds, verified notifications and reconciliation.
- Shared TypeScript contracts, modular APIs, tests and Docker deployment.

## Reuse

Copy the single-instance project for a business scenario and configure the portal, AppID and environment. Each business owns its products, pricing, orders, refund rules and fulfillment.

## Try it on WeChat

The Mini Program is live. Scan this original Mini Program code using WeChat, or save the image and recognize it in WeChat.

content_zh:
## 项目定位

custom_wechat_app 是基于 Taro 与 React 构建的微信小程序底座框架，配套 NestJS API、Prisma 与 PostgreSQL，将常见客户端能力与服务端能力沉淀为可复用的全栈工程。

## 核心能力

- 微信登录、用户资料与会话管理。
- 原生能力封装、WebView 接入与应用隔离认证。
- 私有 OSS 文件上传与短期签名读取。
- 微信支付 API v3、退款、通知验证与对账。
- TypeScript 共享契约、模块化 API、测试及 Docker 部署。

## 复用方式

按业务场景复制单实例工程，替换门户、AppID 与环境配置。业务项目自行维护商品、定价、业务订单、退款规则与履约，底座提供通用能力。

## 微信扫码体验

小程序已上线。请使用微信扫描下方小程序码；在手机上可保存原图后在微信中识别。

![custom_wechat_app 微信小程序码](/api/archive/files?path=tbtparent-me%2Fprojects%2Fcustom-wechat-app%2Fwechat-code-20261002.jpg)

description_en: A Flutter app foundation separating visual design from reusable capabilities, with Alipay, WeChat, Amap and Umeng SDKs. Three peer platforms—app integration, technical operations and business operations—work with shared app backend services.
content_en:
## Overview

custom_app combines a Flutter foundation with **three peer platforms: App Integration, Technical Operations and Business Operations**. Each platform has a distinct responsibility and works with shared app backend services.

## App Foundation: Independent UI and Capabilities

Individual apps own their pages, branding and business flows. Startup, privacy gates, sessions, routing, remote configuration and updates are reusable non-visual mechanisms. Contracts connect business features to platform adapters.

Alipay, WeChat, Amap and Umeng SDKs are integrated. WebView, Bridge and the JSSDK connect web applications to native location, media, files, permissions and sharing.

## App Integration Platform

Manages business app registration, entry points, trusted origins, user authorization and device capability access, providing common integration rules for native pages, WebViews and external apps.

## Technical Operations Platform

Manages application and service health through monitoring, log tracing, jobs, versions and releases, supporting troubleshooting and daily maintenance.

## Business Operations Platform

Manages portal composition, content, assets, service catalogs and user feedback to support ongoing user-facing operations.

## Shared App Backend Services

Shared services provide accounts, sessions, privacy consent, portal data, content, assets, files, call audit summaries and business events. The companion custom_app_backend uses NestJS, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Redis, BullMQ and MinIO.

The three platforms sit at the same architectural level, with technical and business operations handled by their respective platforms.
content_zh:
## 项目定位

custom_app 是以 Flutter App 底座为核心、由三个并列平台协同组成的综合性应用体系：**应用接入平台、运维平台、运营平台**。三个平台各自承担独立职责，App 支撑服务提供共同的服务基础。

## App 底座：样式与能力解耦

页面、品牌和业务流程由具体 App 独立定制；启动、隐私门禁、账号会话、路由、远程配置与更新等通用机制沉淀为非视觉底座。业务通过契约调用能力，平台差异由适配器承接。

已集成支付宝、微信、高德和友盟 SDK。通过 WebView、Bridge 与 JSSDK 连接网页业务和原生能力，统一定位、媒体、文件、权限、分享等能力的调用方式。

## 应用接入平台

负责业务应用的登记与接入管理，包括应用信息、服务入口、可信来源、用户授权和设备能力授权，为原生页面、WebView 及外部应用提供统一接入规则。

## 运维平台

负责应用与服务的运行管理，覆盖服务监控、日志追踪、任务管理、版本与发布，支撑故障定位和日常运维。

## 运营平台

负责应用内容与服务运营，覆盖门户编排、内容管理、素材管理、服务目录和用户反馈，支撑面向用户的持续运营。

## 共同的 App 支撑服务

App 支撑服务为客户端和三个平台提供账号认证与会话、隐私同意、门户数据、内容、素材、文件、调用留痕和业务事件等公共服务。配套后端 custom_app_backend 采用 NestJS、Prisma、PostgreSQL、Redis、BullMQ 与 MinIO。

三个平台处于同一层级，通过职责分工共同服务于 App；运维与运营分别由各自的平台承担。
